text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation Festival!
To entertain the fans who always cheer them on,
the Umamusume take on various competitions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Naturally, Duramente would be participating as well, and this time, she was fired up with extraordinary determination—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look!
Duramente is here...!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh, Racewear~! So cool!
But... why are you standing with your hands on your hips?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —You folks over there.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, us?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind,
I would like you to have this.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Is this the schedule for the competition?
The handwriting looks kind of rough, though...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I wrote it myself.
This is the list of events I'm participating in today.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Handwritten?! I mean... it's written so densely, are you really entering all of these?!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Basketball, volleyball, tennis, dodgeball, baseball,
soccer, badminton, scavenger hunt...
E-Even a bread-eating race!?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I hope to showcase my abilities in as many events as possible.
choice_data_list: Dura, the first event is about to start!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Well then,
I'll be waiting.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, that's an Umamusume from an athletic family for you.
Talk about tough.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Still, why are there so many coming out...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —The Fan Appreciation Festival is a chance to get even more people to support us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few weeks before the Fan Appreciation Festival.
Showing me a schedule packed with competitions, Duramente began to speak with utter seriousness.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I want to show everyone what I'm capable of
and live up to all their expectations."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"If possible,
from everyone who visited the Fan Appreciation Festival."
choice_data_list: Even so, isn't this a bit too much...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: No problem.
choice_data_list: Still, where are you going to take a break?
Still, where are you going to take a break?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
We just need to create some extra time
with games where mercy-rule wins are possible.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, Trainer.
—You know my clan, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: True to her word, Duramente delivered a sensational performance right from the initial soccer match.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Pass!!
Over here!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Hah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (K-KLAAANG!)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Duramente!! Another goal!
That makes five goals in total for her this match...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
A brilliant dribble followed by
a shot right off the crossbar!
Even if you saw that coming, there's no way you're saving it!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
H-Holy crap...!
Duramente showed no mercy!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Next!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*whistle*...... *KABOOM!*)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Duramente does it again—!
A new record has been set today in the shot put!
What an overwhelming display of athletic ability!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Is Duramente really that amazing...!?
Whoa, what race is she entering next!?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Next...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ――...Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoosh... pop)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Duramente shoots and scores!!
A deep three with everything she's got!
And that's the game!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
J-Just how far are you going, Duramente...!
...I'm watching this to the very end!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
...Next!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, just as she declared, Duramente continued
to produce overwhelming results across various sports—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The next one is the final event...
The Bread-Eating Race, huh?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I will win. Without fail.
I'll win... and earn everyone's support.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even without pushing herself so hard, there are already so many people cheering her on, but...
For now, I just want to bear witness to Duramente's resolve.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And it's about to begin—
the fan-favorite Bread-Eating Race!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume to watch this time is undefeated so far!
The strongest Umamusume, Duramente!
Will she show us her strength in eating bread too?!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
!?
How to eat—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: And they're off!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, all eyes were on Duramente, but she had a slow start!
The crowd erupts into a buzz of disbelief!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume lunge for the bread all at once!
Duramente, who got a slow start, has caught up now... but she seems to be struggling!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Guh...!
I-It's shaking...—

text_block_list.name: Gray Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Chomp!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
One after another, the Umamusume grab bread in their mouths!
Now, what will Duramente do?!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Guh...!
—GRAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
All participants in the 'Bread Eating Race' have crossed the finish line!
The crowd favorite, Duramente,
has unfortunately suffered a defeat!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: *pant*... Dammit...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Duramenteee!!
Great job out thereee!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
You worked so hard all day!
I was watching you the whole time! Great job~~!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Even though I lost...
you still came to speak to me?)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...It's warm.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh,
Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Duramente suffered a defeat,
she was enveloped in warm applause...
and seemed to find a sense of fulfillment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
What a shock! The winner is Duramente!
Surging from a seemingly hopeless position, she cuts through the field with a flawless final burst!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, Trainer.
Just let me stand until the very end."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the fatigue from such fierce battles had hit her all at once—Duramente looks exhausted.
Even so, she wipes away her sweat out of view of the crowd—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Duramenteee!!
You were so ridiculously cool out there!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I want to see that intensity in the next race too!
I'm rooting for you!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Sticking with it all day long... that's incredible...!
I thought she was the cool type, but she's got a real passionate side too...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I believe today I was able to demonstrate my strength
in a way other than just racing.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If I have everyone's support pushing me forward,
I can become even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Please—lend me your strength from here on out, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'll cheer for you!
Go for it, Duramente—!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"I became your fan today!
I'll be cheering for you when you take on the world, too!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...It's warm.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
—I received everything you gave me.
